author: Parash Gurung
review_text: You guys have monopoly in the market so the service has got lot worse. Always there is fault in transaction. From the bank side the transaction is complete but it never shows in the esewa account. Doesn't have proper rollback mechanism, doesn't have fault detection. When the money is stuck, there is no quick solution we have to wait for days. The main purpose of this app is to have quick and reliable payment system but seems like it has forgoten its objective and focus more on only marketing etc
